package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestReadinessMigrationKeepsPlannerReceiptMutableAndRollbackFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/002_practice_runtime_readiness_receipt.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/002_practice_runtime_readiness_receipt.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, field := range []string{"'readiness_receipt'", "'readiness_idempotency_key'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(up), "- "+field) {
			t.Errorf("up migration does not exclude mutable field %s from immutable step comparison", field)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(down), "cannot roll back readiness receipt support") ||
		!strings.Contains(string(down), "practice_task_instances") {
		t.Fatal("down migration must fail closed when persisted readiness receipts exist")
	}
}

func TestSubmitIntentPayloadMigrationBackfillsCanonicalReceipts(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/003_practice_submit_intent_payload.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/003_practice_submit_intent_payload.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{
		"ADD COLUMN payload JSONB",
		"UPDATE practice_submit_intents",
		"'validation_specification', validation_specification",
		"'snapshot', snapshot",
		"ALTER COLUMN payload SET NOT NULL",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(up), required) {
			t.Fatalf("submit intent payload migration missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(down), "DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS payload") {
		t.Fatal("submit intent payload migration has no reversible down operation")
	}
}
